instrument: QUADAS-2 (Whiting et al., Ann Intern Med 2011;155:529-536)
scope: studies contributing at least one estimate to the primary pool
eligibility_circularity_en: Every study assessed is high risk and high concern for patient selection because every eligible estimate is a case-versus-healthy-control contrast. That is partly by construction: the review's eligibility rule required that contrast, and 13 estimates from 9 studies were excluded for using another one ({'differential_diagnosis': 4, 'within_disease': 3, 'prodromal_vs_control': 6}). The clinically relevant comparisons - this disease against its mimics, and prodromal against control - exist in the literature and were set aside by the PICO, not missing from it. The honest reading is that the pooled estimates answer an easier question than the clinical one, and are upper bounds for that reason.
eligibility_circularity_pt: Todo estudo avaliado e de alto risco e alta preocupacao em selecao de pacientes porque toda estimativa elegivel e um contraste caso-versus-controle-saudavel. Isso e em parte por construcao: a regra de elegibilidade da revisao exigiu esse contraste, e 13 estimativas de 9 estudos foram excluidas por usarem outro ({'differential_diagnosis': 4, 'within_disease': 3, 'prodromal_vs_control': 6}). As comparacoes clinicamente relevantes - esta doenca contra seus imitadores, e prodromico contra controle - existem na literatura e foram postas de lado pelo PICO, nao faltam nele. A leitura honesta e que as estimativas agrupadas respondem a uma pergunta mais facil que a clinica, e sao limites superiores por isso.
full_text_pass_en: The reference standard and flow-and-timing domains were closed by reading the full texts, not by inference: 22 of 28 studies have a retrievable full text, 13 name the diagnostic criteria they applied, 1 has neuropathological confirmation, and 1 states that diagnosis was blind to the index test. None of the 22 reports a STARD flow diagram, which is why flow and timing is unclear for every study rather than high or low. The six studies without a retrievable full text are unclear because the report could not be read, and the record says which reason applies to which study.
full_text_pass_pt: Os dominios de padrao de referencia e de fluxo e tempo foram fechados lendo os textos completos, nao por inferencia: 22 dos 28 estudos tem texto completo recuperavel, 13 nomeiam os criterios diagnosticos que aplicaram, 1 tem confirmacao neuropatologica e 1 declara que o diagnostico foi cego ao teste indice. Nenhum dos 22 traz fluxograma STARD, e por isso fluxo e tempo fica incerto em todos os estudos em vez de alto ou baixo. Os seis estudos sem texto completo recuperavel ficam incertos porque o relato nao pode ser lido, e o registro diz qual razao vale para qual estudo.
